Now I understand the vulnerability. The issue is at line 1220-1221:
```c
int with1literal = prevMatch.price + LIT_PRICE(ip+cur) + LL_INCPRICE(1);
int withMoreLiterals = price + LIT_PRICE(ip+cur) + LL_INCPRICE(litlen+1);
```

`LIT_PRICE(ip+cur)` calls `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost(ip+cur, 1, ...)` which reads `literals[0]` = `ip[cur]`. When `ip + cur >= iend`, this reads beyond the valid input buffer, accessing uninitialized memory.

The fix adds `LIKELY(ip + cur < iend)` check before this block.
